lines.say: Hee-eh Hee-eh no Mee. The Ice-Ice Fruit. The power to freeze anything... even the sea.
lines.show: Hie Hie no Mi. The Ice-Ice Fruit. The power to freeze anything... even the sea.

lines.say: It's a Lohjeeah fruit. Its user can make ice, control ice, and turn into ice.
lines.show: It's a Logia fruit. Its user can make ice, control ice, and turn into ice.

lines.say: It belonged to Koozahn, the Marine Admiral known as Ah-oh-kee-jee.
lines.show: It belonged to Kuzan, the Marine Admiral known as Aokiji.

lines.say: His attacks even have English names. Ice Saber. Ice Block: Partisan. Ice Time.
lines.show: His attacks even have English names. Ice Saber. Ice Block: Partisan. Ice Time.

lines.say: At Long Ring Long Land, he froze Luffy solid.
lines.show: At Long Ring Long Land, he froze Luffy solid.

lines.say: At Marineford, two giant tsunamis came crashing in. He froze them both, then froze the bay. Ice Age.
lines.show: At Marineford, two giant tsunamis came crashing in. He froze them both, then froze the bay. Ice Age.

lines.say: Later, he faced Admiral Ahkahyeenoo for the title of Fleet Admiral. Ice against magma. For ten days.
lines.show: Later, he faced Admiral Akainu for the title of Fleet Admiral. Ice against magma. For ten days.

lines.say: Their duel on Punk Hazard left the island half frozen and half burning.
lines.show: Their duel on Punk Hazard left the island half frozen and half burning.

lines.say: He lost, and lost a leg too. Now he walks on a leg made of ice. And he quit the Marines.
lines.show: He lost, and lost a leg too. Now he walks on a leg made of ice. And he quit the Marines.

lines.say: His ride? A bicycle, rolling across the ocean on a road of ice he freezes himself.
lines.show: His ride? A bicycle, rolling across the ocean on a road of ice he freezes himself.

lines.say: Today he sails with the Blackbeard Pirates, as one of their Ten Titanic Captains.
lines.show: Today he sails with the Blackbeard Pirates, as one of their Ten Titanic Captains.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
